A source stores what it publishes: GeoMet publishes speed and direction and no components anywhere, GRIB feeds publish components. Speed and direction reconstructed from components are derived-here and are served beside the raw values, never in place of them. Where a producer publishes speed only (REPS), direction stays null and nothing derives one.
